# 🌍 AI Travel Assistant

A full-stack web application that automatically generates personalized day-by-day travel itineraries using multiple AI models.

---

## 📌 Project Overview

AI Travel Assistant allows users to input their destination, travel style, budget, and trip duration — then instantly receive a structured travel plan generated by AI.

The system supports multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) including **Groq LLaMA 3.3**, **Google Gemini**, **OpenAI GPT-4o mini**, and **Ollama (local)**, giving users the flexibility to choose their preferred AI model.

This project was developed as a Computer Science senior project at **Kasetsart University (2025)**.

---

## 🧠 Key Concept

Planning trips manually is time-consuming and overwhelming for many travelers. This system helps users quickly generate realistic, structured, and personalized travel plans — complete with an interactive map showing all recommended locations.

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack

### Frontend
- Vue 3
- Axios
- Vue Router
- i18n (Thai / English / Korean)
- Leaflet.js (Interactive Map)

### Backend
- Python
- Flask (RESTful API)
- JWT Authentication

### Database
- MariaDB

### AI Models Supported
| Model | Provider | Cost |
|-------|----------|------|
| LLaMA 3.3 | Groq | Free (quota) |
| Gemini | Google | Free tier available |
| GPT-4o mini | OpenAI | Paid (API key required) |
| Ollama | Local | Free (runs locally) |

### Tools
- Git & GitHub
- Postman (API testing)
- Python SciPy (statistical analysis)

---

## ✨ Features

### 👤 User Features
- User registration and login (JWT authentication)
- Create travel plans based on:
  - Destination
  - Number of days
  - Travel style
  - Budget
  - Transportation mode
  - Language preference
- Choose preferred AI model for generation
- View generated itinerary day-by-day
- Interactive map with pinned recommended locations
- Save and manage trip history
- User profile page

### 🤖 AI Features
- Generates personalized day-by-day travel itineraries
- Supports 4 AI models (Groq LLaMA 3.3, Gemini, GPT-4o mini, Ollama)
- Suggests activities and places to visit with time slots
- Returns structured JSON itinerary with coordinates for map display

### ⚙️ System Features
- REST API architecture
- Multilingual UI (Thai / English / Korean) via i18n
- Secure JWT authentication
- Relational database design (MariaDB)
- Interactive map (Leaflet.js)

## 🔗 API Endpoints

### 🔐 Register
```http
POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/register
```
```json
{
  "name": "Test User",
  "email": "test@example.com",
  "password": "123456"
}
```

### 🔐 Login
```http
POST http://localhost:8000/api/users/login
```
```json
{
  "email": "test@example.com",
  "password": "123456"
}
```
```json
{
  "token": "jwt_token_here"
}
```

### 👤 Get Current User
```http
GET http://localhost:8000/api/users/me
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### 🧭 Generate Travel Plan
```http
POST http://localhost:8000/api/ai/generate-trip-plan
Content-Type: application/json
```
```json
{
  "destination": "Bangkok, Thailand",
  "trip_days": 3,
  "travel_style": "relax",
  "budget": "medium",
  "transportation": "taxi",
  "language": "en",
  "ai_model": "groq"
}
```

### 💾 Get My Trips
```http
GET http://localhost:8000/api/trips/user
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### 📄 Get Trip Detail
```http
GET http://localhost:8000/api/trips/{id}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### 📋 Get All Trips
```http
GET http://localhost:8000/api/trips/
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## 🗄 Database Design (Simplified)

**Tables:**
- `users` — stores user accounts
- `trips` — stores saved travel plans
- `itinerary_days` — stores day-by-day schedule per trip

**Relationships:**
- User → Trips (1:M)
- Trip → Itinerary Days (1:M)

## 🚀 How to Run the Project

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.x
- Node.js
- MariaDB
- API keys for Groq / Gemini / OpenAI (optional)

### Backend
```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
# Set up your .env file with API keys and DB credentials
python app.py
```

### Frontend
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Environment Variables (`.env`)
GROQ_API_KEY=your_groq_api_key
GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_NAME=travel_ai
DB_USER=root
DB_PASSWORD=your_password
JWT_SECRET=your_secret_key

## 📊 Research & Evaluation

This project includes a research component evaluating the quality of AI-generated itineraries:

- **14 travel plans** generated using Groq LLaMA 3.3
- **71 human evaluators** across 3 languages (Thai / English / Korean)
- **3 AI Judges** (Gemini, OpenRouter trinity-mini, Groq) used for automated evaluation
- Statistical analysis using **Shapiro-Wilk**, **Kruskal-Wallis**, and **Mann-Whitney U Test**

**Key Finding:** LLM-generated itineraries achieved consistently high perceived quality across multiple languages and cultural backgrounds.
